Update only the existing branch codex/run-38443286322-1; its head must be 624644657d632d423a2c030e91165c51c54ec6fa (full SHA from git rev-parse of origin/codex/run-38443286322-1; if it differs, stop and report the SHA you found). Part A is already on this branch: read its two commits first (git log -p origin/main..HEAD -- deploy/ scripts/operator/lib scripts/v3_archetype_calibration_complete.py scripts/dev/convert_calibration_histogram.py) so you build on what is there: deploy/v3-production/f2d-operator-code.txt (the operator-code manifest; the identity REFUSES on a listed path that does not exist, and a manifest-listed file that changes moves the identity -- tests compute it dynamically, nothing pins the value), scripts/operator/lib/f2d_operator_identity.{sh,py} (compute_operator_code_sha256, require_operator_code_identity, F2D_OPERATOR_CODE_SHA256_ATTESTED), scripts/v3_archetype_calibration_complete.py (the sealed complete receipt: mode complete, content_sha256, system_count, per_archetype.<key>.tier_histogram S/A/B/C/D totals, chunk_plan {chunk_count, sha256}, per_chunk {file, bytes, sha256} binding an append-only per-chunk.jsonl log, sigma_all, coefficients, code_identity, archetype_model_sha256, model_file_sha256, f2d_operator_code_sha256, expected_product_manifest; validate_complete_receipt and validate_per_chunk_log are the consumer helpers), and scripts/dev/convert_calibration_histogram.py (writes the fractions JSON with fractions_sha256, source_receipt_content_sha256, source_f2d_operator_code_sha256, converter_f2d_operator_code_sha256). Parts B2 (the capacity gate action that consumes these receipts), C and D follow on this branch; leave it in a state they can continue from. No pull request is opened until every part has landed.

AUTHORITY: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-v3-finder-f2d-wide-archetype-and-product-attachment-design.md. Read CLAUDE.md first, then design section 8.2 paragraph "The eligible footprint receipt is produced here, not by PR1" (the workflow), section 8.3 (identities; every receipt records the identity of the checkout that produced it), section 8.4 in full -- items (b), (e), the Arithmetic block, the paragraph "The Search term is measured, never the ~87 GB fixture figure" and the paragraph "Fixed-cost fields for the resume arithmetic" -- and the PR4 bullet in section 10. Read also scripts/dev/measure_wide_archetype_footprint.py in full (the --migration-sql final-migration mode, assert_disposable_server, MEASUREMENT_DATABASE_PREFIX, per_row_costs, capacity_gate_eligible, the comment that says f2d_operator_code_sha256 is PR4's), sql/v3/migrations/004_v3_search_spatial_clusters.sql (v3_derived.system_search pre-010 DDL: name text NOT NULL CHECK length 1..256, region_name and main_star_class nullable CHECK length 1..128, and every index on the table), sql/v3/migrations/010_v3_system_search_body_type_counts.sql (18 NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 integer columns), sql/v3/migration-manifest.txt (the registered order), .github/workflows/ratings-v4-freeze.yml (the PostgreSQL 18 service container, setup-python 3.14 and dependency install pattern to copy, with the same pinned action SHAs), and tests/test_ci_stall_detection.py (CHECKED_WORKFLOWS must list every workflow file; add the new one and satisfy that test's contract). Where this task and the design differ, the design wins; where the design and the current code differ, follow the design and name the conflict in your summary. Everything here is code only: no deployment, no production access, no production credentials. The workflow runs ONLY on a disposable GitHub-hosted PostgreSQL 18 service container, never against production.

ALLOWED FILES: scripts/dev/measure_search_footprint.py (new); scripts/dev/measure_wide_archetype_footprint.py (the additions below only; the default pre-migration mode, the committed v1..v4 layouts and every existing receipt field stay byte-for-byte compatible); scripts/operator/lib/f2d_evidence.py (new, the shared evidence-path constants and sealed-receipt loader; pure stdlib); deploy/v3-production/f2d-operator-code.txt (add scripts/dev/measure_search_footprint.py and scripts/operator/lib/f2d_evidence.py, keeping it sorted; the identity tests in tests/test_f2d_operator_identity.py list the expected active entries -- extend EXPECTED_ACTIVE_ENTRIES); .github/workflows/v3-finder-capacity-measurement.yml (new); tests/test_measure_search_footprint.py (new), tests/test_measure_wide_archetype_footprint.py (extend), tests/test_f2d_evidence.py (new), tests/test_v3_finder_capacity_measurement_workflow.py (new), tests/test_f2d_operator_identity.py (EXPECTED_ACTIVE_ENTRIES only), tests/test_ci_stall_detection.py (add the workflow to CHECKED_WORKFLOWS), tests/test_python314_execution_surfaces.py only if new Python entry points must be listed; CHANGES.md. Any other changed path must be justified in your summary as required by a specific failing test, otherwise it is a failure. Do not touch scripts/v3_archetype_calibration_complete.py, the identity helpers, the converter, the complete-read action or chatgpt-ed-new-ops.yml in this part.

EVIDENCE PATHS (scripts/operator/lib/f2d_evidence.py). The rollout commits its evidence at FIXED repository paths so no task text, workflow input or argument can route a consumer to a different file: EVIDENCE_DIR = docs/operations/evidence/f2d; COMPLETE_RECEIPT = <dir>/complete-read-receipt.json; COEFFICIENT_DECISION = <dir>/coefficient-decision.json; FRACTIONS = <dir>/calibration-fractions.json; ARCHETYPE_FOOTPRINT = <dir>/archetype-footprint-receipt.json; SEARCH_FOOTPRINT = <dir>/search-footprint-receipt.json; STEP0_RECEIPT = docs/operations/evidence/2026-10-10-v3-derived-lifecycle-status-receipt.json (exists). Provide canonical_json / canonical_sha256 (sort_keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii, allow_nan=False -- byte-identical to the complete-read program's), seal(body) adding content_sha256, and load_sealed(path) that refuses (named ValueError) a missing path, a symlink, invalid JSON, a non-object, a missing or malformed content_sha256, or a seal that does not verify. None of these files exist yet except the step 0 receipt; do not create placeholder evidence files.

SEARCH FOOTPRINT (scripts/dev/measure_search_footprint.py; design 8.4 "The Search term is measured" and "Fixed-cost fields"). Same disposable-server discipline as the archetype script: EDFINDER_DISPOSABLE_DSN, assert_disposable_server, a fresh CREATE DATABASE with a search_measure_ prefix dropped in finally, loopback PostgreSQL 18 only, refuse otherwise. It measures the 010 delta the only valid way (the design explains why a populated table sized before and after ALTER TABLE reads near zero): build the SAME synthetic rows three times from EMPTY, each in a fresh schema state: (1) PRE-010: apply the registered migrations in manifest order up to and excluding 010, fill v3_derived.system_search with N synthetic rows (name, region_name and main_star_class drawn from a declared, seeded, deterministic distribution of realistic lengths -- document the distribution in the module docstring; every other column satisfies the 004 CHECKs), VACUUM ANALYZE, size pg_table_size + every index via pg_relation_size + TOAST (pg_total_relation_size minus the heap gives indexes+toast; record heap, indexes, toast separately); (2) POST-010: fresh database, apply the registered migrations in manifest order through 010 and the later Search migrations that change the table or its indexes (013 if it does; read the manifest and the files, and record the sha256 of EVERY migration file applied in each state), fill the identical rows, VACUUM ANALYZE, size; (3) FIXED: the post-010 state filled with the same N rows but name, region_name and main_star_class each exactly one character (the minimum the CHECKs allow), VACUUM ANALYZE, size. Fill through a parameterized executemany/COPY of the script's own rows (there is no canonical source in this disposable database; say so in the docstring), in 1000-row chunks. Receipt (sealed with content_sha256; pure integers; every division rounds UP): schema_version ed-finder/v3-search-footprint/v1; rows; server_version_num; migrations_applied {pre010: [[path, sha256],...], post010: [...]} ; migration_010_sha256 and migration_004_sha256 pulled out for the gate; pre010 {heap_bytes, index_bytes, toast_bytes, total_bytes, per_index_bytes}; post010 {same}; pre010_bytes_per_row = ceil(pre010.total/rows); post010_bytes_per_row = ceil(post010.total/rows); measured_010_delta_bytes_per_row = ceil((post010.total - pre010.total)/rows), refused if negative; fixed {heap_bytes, index_bytes, toast_bytes, total_bytes}; search_fixed_bytes_per_row = ceil(fixed.total/rows); text_bytes_seeded = sum over the rows of octet_length(name) + COALESCE(octet_length(region_name),0) + COALESCE(octet_length(main_star_class),0) (read back from the post-010 table with one aggregate, matching the design's resume formula); distribution_source 'declared-synthetic-text-v1'; f2d_operator_code_sha256 of the checkout (compute_operator_code_sha256(ROOT), refuse if it raises); capacity_gate_eligible true only when all three states ran on PostgreSQL 18 and the delta is non-negative. CLI: --rows (default 200000), --output <path> (atomic write). Tests (disposable PG18 where needed via EDFINDER_DISPOSABLE_DSN exactly as tests/test_measure_wide_archetype_footprint.py does; pure where possible): the three states apply distinct migration sets and record every hash; the fixed fill's text columns are one byte each; delta is ceil of unrounded difference / rows; a negative delta refuses; the receipt seals and f2d_evidence.load_sealed accepts it; a receipt with any of the four gate fields (pre010_bytes_per_row, post010_bytes_per_row, measured_010_delta_bytes_per_row, search_fixed_bytes_per_row) removed fails a validator function validate_search_footprint_receipt(receipt) that part B2's gate will import; the script refuses a non-loopback or non-18 server before any write.

ARCHETYPE FOOTPRINT ADDITIONS (scripts/dev/measure_wide_archetype_footprint.py, final-migration mode only). (a) f2d_operator_code_sha256 of the checkout in the receipt (replace the "deliberately absent" comment); refuse to write the receipt if the identity computation raises. (b) archetype_fixed_bytes_per_row: the design defines it as heap + primary-key + weighted-index bytes per row "with the shortest archetype name (paradise) in both text columns"; migration 011 CHECKs secondary_archetype <> primary_archetype, so that literal fill is impossible through the builder (name this design-versus-code conflict in your summary). Realize the intent conservatively instead: archetype_fixed_bytes_per_row = ceil((heap_bytes - text_bytes_stored + primary_key_bytes + weighted_index_bytes) / rows), where text_bytes_stored = SUM(octet_length(primary_archetype) + COALESCE(octet_length(secondary_archetype),0)) read from the filled table with one aggregate (the primary key and the weighted index contain no text column, 011 lines 100-104), so the fixed figure contains no variable text and the gate's variable_left term (2 x 63 bytes x rows_left) bounds it from above; record text_bytes_stored and archetype_fixed_bytes_per_row in the receipt. (c) seal the final-migration receipt with content_sha256 over its canonical body (the default-mode receipt is unchanged). (d) a validator validate_archetype_footprint_receipt(receipt) that part B2 imports: requires capacity_gate_eligible true, score_distribution_source 'measured-histogram', the four per-row cost fields, archetype_fixed_bytes_per_row, migration_011_sha256, fractions_sha256, f2d_operator_code_sha256 (64 lowercase hex) and a verifying seal; the committed synthetic receipt docs/operations/evidence/2026-10-10-wide-archetype-footprint-200k.json fed to it must be refused as synthetic and gate-ineligible (a test). Tests in tests/test_measure_wide_archetype_footprint.py: existing tests stay green; the new fields are present and sealed on the disposable-PG18 smoke path; archetype_fixed_bytes_per_row <= heap+pkey+weighted per row; the validator cases above.

WORKFLOW (.github/workflows/v3-finder-capacity-measurement.yml; design 8.2). name: V3 Finder capacity measurement. workflow_dispatch only, inputs: attested_f2d_operator_code_sha256 (required string; the value from the F2d accepted-release attestation), rows (default '200000'). One job, runs-on ubuntu-latest, timeout-minutes 60, concurrency group v3-finder-capacity-measurement, permissions contents: read, the PostgreSQL 18 service container exactly as ratings-v4-freeze.yml declares it (same image reference, health options), actions/checkout and actions/setup-python at the SAME pinned SHAs as ratings-v4-freeze.yml with python-version '3.14', dependencies from apps/api/requirements.txt as that workflow installs them. Steps, each failing closed: (1) validate the input is 64 lowercase hex; (2) compute the checkout identity with BOTH helpers (bash scripts/operator/lib/f2d_operator_identity.sh verify . "$ATTESTED" and python scripts/operator/lib/f2d_operator_identity.py verify . "$ATTESTED") and stop unless both succeed -- a checkout whose identity is not the attested one measures nothing; (3) refuse unless docs/operations/evidence/f2d/complete-read-receipt.json exists (the committed complete-read receipt; the workflow never fetches one); (4) python scripts/dev/convert_calibration_histogram.py <that receipt> --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/calibration-fractions.json"; (5) EDFINDER_DISPOSABLE_DSN=postgresql://<service user>:<service password>@127.0.0.1:5432/<service db> python scripts/dev/measure_wide_archetype_footprint.py --migration-sql sql/v3/migrations/011_v3_system_archetype.sql --fractions-json "$RUNNER_TEMP/calibration-fractions.json" --rows "$ROWS" writing the receipt to "$RUNNER_TEMP/archetype-footprint-receipt.json" (add an --output flag to the script if it only prints; keep printing when --output is absent); (6) python scripts/dev/measure_search_footprint.py --rows "$ROWS" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/search-footprint-receipt.json"; (7) a verification step that loads all three outputs with f2d_evidence.load_sealed, asserts each f2d_operator_code_sha256 equals the attested input, asserts the archetype receipt's fractions_sha256 equals the fractions file's fractions_sha256 and its migration_011_sha256 equals sha256sum of the checked-out 011, and prints the three content_sha256 values; (8) actions/upload-artifact at the SHA chatgpt-ed-new-ops.yml pins, name v3-finder-capacity-measurement, the three receipts plus the fractions file, retention-days 90, if-no-files-found error. The job summary (GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY) lists the four files, their content_sha256 and the identity, and states that a reviewed PR must commit them under docs/operations/evidence/f2d/ at the fixed names from f2d_evidence.py. Workflow contract test tests/test_v3_finder_capacity_measurement_workflow.py: parse with yaml; assert workflow_dispatch-only trigger, the two inputs, the service image equals ratings-v4-freeze.yml's, both identity helpers are invoked before any measurement step, the fixed evidence path appears, the three scripts run in order, no secrets are referenced, no production host or operator credential names (ED_NEW_OPERATOR_) appear, and the artifact name/retention. Add the file to CHECKED_WORKFLOWS in tests/test_ci_stall_detection.py and satisfy whatever that test requires of every workflow (run it).
